Container.Name: Scriptorium
Container.Overview: Self-hosted D&D 5e character, content and campaign platform: character builder and sheets with a rules engine, compendium, homebrew, campaigns, monsters and encounters. Needs a PostgreSQL 17 container (install one from Community Applications first and create a database and user for Scriptorium).

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port the web app listens on

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL 17 connection string (user, password, host, database you created)

Config.Name: APP_SECRET
Config.Description: Random string of at least 32 characters; keep it constant between updates

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: The address users open in their browser (use https://... when behind a reverse proxy)

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: true when behind a reverse proxy such as SWAG or Nginx Proxy Manager

Config.Name: BACKUP_CRON
Config.Description: Cron expression for automatic backups into /data/backups (empty disables)

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: fatal, error, warn, info, debug or trace
